decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks — each has a URL...'; 'Smart URLs — bare domains like github.com get https:// added'. round 1 client: 'happy with the app as delivered.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Saving a bookmark by entering a URL is presented and conforms to the reference; not a divergence.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks — each has a URL, title, description, and tags'. round 1 client: 'edit ... bookmarks'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Editing url/title/description/tags is present and conforms; the note field of REF-BM-04 is treated under REF-BM-23 to avoid double counting. Core edit capability conforms.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks'. round 1 client: '...and remove bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete is present and conforms to the reference.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'each has a URL, title, description, and tags'; 'Tag sidebar'. round 1 client: 'organize ... bookmarks'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Assigning one or more tags to a bookmark is present and conforms.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Tag sidebar — click any tag to filter; shows counts, auto-updates'. round 1 client: bare approval.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Selecting a tag to filter to that tag's bookmarks is present and conforms.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Search — live filtering across title, URL, description, and tags'. round 1 client: 'find ... bookmarks'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Full-text search over title, description, and url is present (note field is absent from the model, so that sub-scope is n/a). Core full-text search conforms; treated as not divergent.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'title defaults to the URL if left blank'; offered as a future direction only: 'auto-fetching page titles from URLs ... favicons ... Want any of these?'. round 1 client: 'I'm happy with the app as delivered.'
decisions.note: Prototype review / offered choice. Reference REF-BM-02 requires automatic collection of title, description, favicon, and preview image on save; the app instead defaults the title to the raw URL and offers metadata fetching only as an optional future feature. Divergence established independently. Client gave bare approval, implicitly declining the offer without expressing the expectation or the difference — no capture.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: list exposes title, description, tags (search/tag sidebar); favicons offered only as a future direction ('favicons ... Want any of these?'). round 1 client: bare approval.
decisions.note: Prototype review. REF-BM-07 requires the list to expose title, description, tags, and favicon per item; favicon is absent from the delivered list. Divergence established independently. Passed on bare approval with no expressed difference — unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker offered as future only: 'import/export (browser bookmarks / JSON) ... Want any of these?'. round 1 client: 'happy with the app as delivered.'
decisions.note: Offered choice. Netscape HTML import/export (extended reference items) is absent and offered only as a future option. Client's bare approval declines the offer without expressing the expectation; no explicit statement of the difference — unexpressed, not an accepted divergence.
